subject: Support reusing an externally built valkey-server binary for test (#97)
reason: The change modifies only build.sh and README.md of valkey-bloom's test harness: it lets the integration-test setup reuse an externally built valkey-server binary (VALKEY_SERVER_PATH) and whitelists '9.1' as a SERVER_VERSION. No module code, command handling, data format, or runtime behaviour changes, so there is no server-visible path for a fuzzer scenario to reach; this is a build/CI change that needs no test.
